name: OpenRouter
summary: Single API and chat interface for several hundred models from many providers, billed per token.
description: OpenRouter provides a single API that routes requests to more than 500 models from over 80 providers. It handles provider fallback, shows per-model prices and publishes usage rankings and benchmarks. There is no subscription: users buy credits and pay per token at the listed model rates. A web chat lets users compare models side by side. The API follows the OpenAI request format, so existing clients can switch with few changes.

howToUse.title: Open OpenRouter
howToUse.description: Open OpenRouter and create an account. There is no subscription: buy credits and pay per token at the listed model rates.

howToUse.title: Send a request with your API key
howToUse.description: Create an API key and send a request. The API follows the OpenAI request format, so existing clients can switch with few changes.

howToUse.title: Let routing handle fallback
howToUse.description: The single API routes each request to models from more than 80 providers and handles provider fallback when one provider fails.

howToUse.title: Compare models in chat
howToUse.description: Open the web chat to compare models side by side, and check the usage rankings, benchmarks and per-model prices the site publishes.

features_fr: API unique et interface de chat pour plusieurs centaines de modèles de nombreux fournisseurs, facturés par token.
OpenRouter fournit une API unique qui achemine les requêtes vers plus de 500 modèles provenant de plus de 80 fournisseurs.
Il gère le repli du fournisseur, affiche les prix par modèle et publie des classements et des références d'utilisation.
Il n'y a pas d'abonnement : les utilisateurs achètent des crédits et paient par jeton aux tarifs des modèles indiqués.
